purpose: Descriptive feasibility check using already saved six-firm Yahoo extraction; never a frozen/approved dataset v1 or coverage validation
value: simple adjacent-observed-session adjusted-close return; no imputation or market residualization
label_rule: Existing classify_regimes at each return date: strictly pre-date VIX, 20-observation mean, trailing five calendar years, earlier rolling means p25/p75, strict below/above; equality mixed
comparison: Pair-specific Pearson correlation on common dates, separate calm/mixed/turbulent labels; all firm pairs enumerated; undefined and insufficient pairs retained
inference: Descriptive only; no p-value, no IID confidence interval, no coverage, no hypothesis confirmation
limitations: Security identity, provider accuracy and point-in-time adjustments not certified
SPY-observed sessions are not independent exchange-calendar completeness validation
Prices and source VIX levels are not redistributed
Dates/labels and aggregate statistics can be shared; recomputation of price statistics requires licensed local inputs
Event-specific label design extended to dates for this exploratory feasibility check; not ratified as the team's daily regime definition
